ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(NOT(REGEX( Vanity_URL__c , "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]*$")), NOT($Profile.Name="System Administrator"), NOT($Profile.Name="Tanium System Administrator"), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules))
/*AND(NOT(REGEX( Vanity_URL__c , "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]*$")),NOT($Profile.Name="Tanium System Administrator"))*/
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Vanity is typically the customer name and will be in the link to the TaaS instance: [vanity].cloud.tanium.com, for example abccompany.cloud.tanium.com. Please enter only the vanity portion in this field. Alphanumeric text ONLY, hyphen allowed.
